timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can admit that I feel nervous about this presentation.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I can feel the pressure building.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Part of me is afraid I’ll mess up.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I keep imagining what could go wrong.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: I can feel this nervousness in my body.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I really want to do well.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I don’t have to pretend I’m not nervous.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can notice this pressure without fighting it.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This is a lot to carry right now.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. Maybe your breathing feels a little deeper, or there’s a little more room in your chest. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can make room for these nerves and still move forward.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I don’t need to feel perfectly calm.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can let one breath be enough.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can loosen my grip on getting everything right.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body is allowed to soften.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I know more than my nerves are telling me.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can take this one sentence at a time.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can let my preparation support me.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can make a little more room for confidence.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You don’t need every nervous feeling to disappear. See if there’s simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment. You’re doing a good job creating space for yourself.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I’m ready to show up as I am.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I can speak clearly and take my time.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I trust what I already know.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can recover if I lose my place.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: I don’t need to be perfect to be effective.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: My voice deserves space.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can stay with myself through this moment.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I’m capable, prepared, and present.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I’m ready to begin.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you begin.
